GOOD QUESTIONS

Before you start.

Does Sq9 Origin predict the market?

No. Geometry and astronomical event times are research inputs. Neither establishes future price direction, profitable trades, or a validated strategy.

Is the supplied Pine indicator using DE442s?

No. The supplied JPL Astronomy Integrated v8 calculates approximate positions from orbital elements and a separate lunar series. The web terminal is a different engine designed to publish DE442s crossings. Its initial data publication is currently pending.

Can I send terminal data directly into Pine v8?

The web terminal offers event exports when data is available, but the supplied v8 indicator has no verified external event input. A compatible Pine bridge must be confirmed before assuming the two can exchange events.

What do the access plans include?

The published options are $25 USD per month and $311 USD per year. Contact support to confirm included tools, activation, renewal, and cancellation terms. This preview does not process payments.
